en: Hooooooo... haaaaaaaa!
How on earth... how could\nsomething like this exist...!
Haeeeeee... hieeeeeee!
Is this really the satellite\nMastima...?
According to the scans, there\nshouldn't have been any signs\nof life or civilization here...!
Uoooooo... guoooooo!
There shouldn't be any records\nof structures like this on\nDaftes either...
Uguooooooo... gaaaaaaa!
...Euwin, make sure you hold\nonto Welch tightly.
If she starts running wild here,\nI don't think anyone will be able\nto stop her.
L-leave it to me! Even if it\ncosts me my life...!
Let go... show me... show me\nsomething I've never seen\nbefore...!
...What is with this kid...?
Hehe... Everyone is exactly the\nsame. It makes me happy.
Yeah. I know it was only a brief\nmoment for the Captain and\nthe others.
But for me... well, it was a\nmoment I'd been longing for for\na very long time.
...Still, I cannot believe it. To\nthink Tika would appear in\nsuch a form...
I couldn't believe it at first\neither. To travel back in time\ntwice in such a short span...
So that is how it was.
Tika, you leaped even further\ninto the past from the moment\nwe were fighting in Asyl.
Just how far...?
About eight years, I think.
S-so long...!
But as you can see, I'm doing\ngreat.

A lot of hard things happened,
but I just knew... I knew that I
would definitely get to see
everyone again.
You knew...?
Yeah. Oh, look, over there!

Waaaaaaah!! T-the Royal
Capital's Great Emblem
Windmill... it's not a fake... it's
not a fake!!
Why... was I unable to scan a\nstructure of this magnitude...?
That's where the master of\nthis planet resides... the\nEmblem Museum, Ex Giva.
Welcome, children of other\nworlds.
I am Mastima. A failed\nSymbolist who was cast out of\nparadise.
I also happen to serve as the\ndirector of this Symbol\nMuseum, Ex Giva.
Mastima...? The same name as\nthe moon...
It is not that I share a name\nwith this satellite.
Rather, my name was\nbestowed upon this satellite.
That is an important\ndistinction.
Cast out of paradise... what do\nyou mean by that?
Hmm. Young scientist of\nLevarance. Are you unaware of\nthe traces of paradise?

However... you there, the
Earthling. And you, the puppet.
I imagine you two understand
what I mean.
Hehehe, you look surprised. I\nlove that look on your faces.
...The puppet. You mean me,\nMaster Mastima.
If you're unaware of it, then\nyou're truly fortunate.
...I can feel Master Mastima's\nmalice toward me and my\norigins.

However, more than the nature of that
malice, I demand an explanation
regarding the genetic information you
possess.
The genetic information you\ncarry is from my home, EnII...
I see no point in answering\nyour question.

Did you think that playing the
part of a cosmic guardian
would grant you everything you
desire?
W-what?!

It's about time you realized
that there are some things in
this universe that are better
left unknown.

Why don't you stop dancing to
the tune of Vandione's legacy
and try acting on your own will
for once?
To insult that name is a\ndeclaration of war against us\nMorphus...!
Good grief. Even that rigidity is\nexactly like Vandione and his\n"Ex."
This is getting nowhere. Just\nbe quiet.
What...!! You...!!
Valka, hold yourself back.
Let go, Henri! She...!
It seems she knows you, but\nwe know nothing about her.

This is her territory. I don't
believe it would be in our best
interest to make an enemy of
her here.
Tsk...

That said, Mastima, using your
information advantage to
unilaterally insult others is
hardly commendable.

Hehehe, my apologies, my
apologies. I simply get a bit
stirred up whenever I catch a
scent of my homeland.
User of Ex, I apologize for my\nrudeness.
Oh dear, it seems I'm hated.\nHehehe.
...Mastima. It seems you are\nquite well-versed in the affairs\nof the universe.

Well, I suppose so. I pride
myself on being one of the
most knowledgeable beings in
the cosmos.
...It feels as though your will\nand power are heavily involved\nin the reason we are here.
Since you've invited us, I\nassume you'll answer our\nquestions?

Very well. Despite
appearances, I am also quite
interested in you all. Ask me
anything.
Now then, what is it you wish\nto know?
This is the celestial body that\nyou Daftine people call the\nmoon.
No, that's not what I meant.
Is there a reason why it shares\nthe same name as you?
Nothing in particular.

Long ago, I descended to Daftine on
some business, and your ancestors,
who had built a primitive civilization,
asked for my name.
They also asked where I came\nfrom, so I simply answered that\nI was from the moon.
Perhaps that is why?

Wait a minute. The name Mastima has
been recorded in every document for
hundreds of years, alongside the
records of the Holy War.
Just how old are you?
Is it really that surprising,\nyoung lady of the Foxtail?

Judging by the number of your
tails, you must have lived
through a fair amount of time
yourself, no?
Huh? Is that true?

There are significant differences
between stars and individuals, but a
Foxtail's tail grows one every fifty to a
hundred years.
Wha... a hundred years!?
...What?
...One, two... three...
Hey, wait!
...I'm... I'm sorry. For being so\nbratty. I apologize for being\nrude to my elder.
Stop it! That's actually more\nannoying!
It didn't take me a hundred\nyears to grow a tail! At most, it\ntook eighty...
...I'm really, truly sorry.
Welch!! I told you to stop!
Heh heh heh. Well, as you can\nsee, the reasons for longevity\nvary from person to person.

It has been 3.7 billion years
since I was born. I should at
least have a moon named after
me.
Welch & Karlyn: ...Huh?
Hmm, I see. So Earth already\nhas a record of that.
Are you referring to the\n"Paradise" you mentioned\nearlier?
Captain, that's impossible. I... I\ncan't believe that.
You don't have to believe me,\nbut why are you so sure it's\nimpossible?
Do you think your Vandione\nand Ex are the only special\nones?
How vast do you think\nParadise was, and how many\nhumans do you think it held?
What? Ex never mentioned\nanything about...

Just because someone knows
everything doesn't mean they'll
tell you everything. At least,
that's what Vandione said.

Let me give you a piece of
advice. I don't know how that
person's descendants dealt
with Ex, but...

If you fight while blindly
trusting only that thing... your
lifespan as a warrior won't be
very long.
...Valka.
I'll let you strangers in on a\nsecret.
Once, there was a planet called\nNede that ruled seventy\npercent of the galaxy.
I was born at the end of that\nhistory... and was chosen as\none to follow those ten.
Exactly. The "Ten Sages of\nGod."
You've certainly done your\nhomework.
Ten individuals were selected\nfor the First Ten Sages\nDefense Plan...
Aside from Gabriel before the\nfinal adjustments,
Zaphkiel, Jophiel, Metatron,\nZadkiel, Camael,
Raphael, Michael, Haniel, and\nLucifer―those nine were\noperated without a hitch.

Impressed by their utility, the
Nede Defense Force began
preparations for the Second
Ten Sages Defense Plan.
If they had simply continued\nfighting for the defense of\nNede...

Or perhaps if those fools in the
Nede army had been a bit
more cautious... I might have
eventually...
But well, after a series of events, those\nnine went mad, and we were suspected\nof being destined for the same fate.
After fleeing and being\ncaptured, I eventually arrived in\nthis star system.
I didn't look like this back then,\nof course.
That was 3.7 billion years ago.

<font color=blue>Henri</font>: Why were the scanners
on the Captain's and Valka's
ships unable to detect this Ex
Giva?
<font color=blue>Mastima</font>: That's obvious.

My concealment via Symbolism
is so superior that your ship's
scanners stand no chance
against it.

<font color=blue>Verda</font>: Then, could it be that
the mysterious attacks on the
Levarance fleet and Valka's
ship were also...
<font color=blue>Mastima</font>: You all really need to\nbrush up on your skills.
To think you can't overcome a\nsymbol created by a 3.7\nbillion-year-old man.
Even the OS running the\ncomputer is the same <font color=yellow>Lastia</font>\nfrom the old days, you know?
<font color=blue>Valka</font>: <font color=yellow>OS Lastia</font>... Impossible...\nIt shouldn't exist in this\nuniverse anymore.
<font color=blue>Mastima</font>: ...I'm starting to feel\nsorry for you.

As far as I know, there are at
least three other computers
equipped with Lastia besides
this Ex Giva.
<font color=blue>Valka</font>: N-no way...!

At any rate, this Symbol
Museum Ex Giva continues to
expand infinitely to satisfy my
Academic Thirst.

It is a hall of Gems dedicated
to the pursuit of universal
truth, originating from my
snow-covered homeland.

A tower engraving the truths
of the universe, which remain
unsolved even after a lifetime
of effort.
A tower that exposes the\ntruths of the universe.
A grand "waste" that exists\nonly because stuffing it with\nmy wisdom is never enough.
A waste?
A waste.
And that is exactly how it\nshould be.

This desire to research the
concept of Gems endlessly is
the very reason I could never
become one of the Ten Sages.
To begin with, Tika, how\nexactly did you end up here on\nthe Ex Giva?

While the Captain and the others were
fighting at the Holy Land of Asyl,
Rekoro, Coro, and I were caught in the
Moonshadow Ladder and sent into the
past.
We were thrown out onto this\nsatellite, and Mastima took us\nin and protected us right away.
That happened eight years\nago.
It was a rare, stimulating event.

Even for me, it was the first time I'd
heard of a case where someone
traveled back in time twice in a row
without using a Time Gate.
On the Ex Giva, it's not just the\nMoonshadow Ladder...
Mastima protects many people\nwho became lost in space for\nvarious reasons.
I was just like them, and\nMastima helped me so much.
She gave me everything I could\never want.
That's why I asked her.
I told her I wanted the power\nto fight!
...Damn it.
Hm?
Look, Big Sister Verda!
Oh!? Is that... a gun?
I decided that if I was going to\nget the power to fight, I\ndefinitely wanted a gun!
Because I've always looked up\nto you, Big Sister Verda!
Nya!?
...I-I can't believe... you looked\nup to me...
Oh, Tika~!
Y-yeah. That's the first time\nI've ever seen Verda act so\nfidgety.

I'm not staying behind this
time! Now I can fight alongside
the Captain and Big Sister
Verda!
So let's definitely save Big\nSister Eve together!
Nyahuhu... kufufu...
So? General Ricardo. What\nexactly is your relationship with\nthis place and her?
I haven't thanked you for the\ncollar you gave me yet, have I?\nDid you get that here as well?

Come to think of it, you've
been searching for Tika this
whole time. And you spent a
fortune doing it.

Since you were connected to
Mastima, does that mean you
knew about the Tika from
across time or something?
...Guh!
...Hey, it's about time you told\nthe truth.

If it's too hard for you, I'll say it. Either
way, once you take off the armor and
mask, Sister Valka will figure it out
immediately.
...Do as you please.

...Ricardo Franz was just a fake name
used to trick the "me" from when I was
little, back when I was traveling with
Sister Verda and the others.

Since it's the name of a
famous historical figure, my
younger self didn't suspect a
thing.
But his real name is...
Ricardo Blanche.
He is my real older brother.
What...?
WHAAAAAAAT!?
No way, no way! You can't be\nserious!
Tika, you never mentioned a\nword about having a brother...
Wait, did she? Did she say\nsomething...?

She did! She mentioned not
being able to get in touch with
her brother... I never would
have guessed!
I'm sorry for the confusion.\nBrother Ricardo and I...
Ri... Ricardo... her brother...
Hey, witch! You got a problem\nwith that?!

My apologies. It's just that getting a
glimpse into another family's private
affairs leaves me feeling... well, a bit
speechless.
Gaaah!!
Hehe. My brother and I are ten\nyears apart.

When my parents and I
emigrated, my brother had
already left home to join the
military.
He was on the warship\nescorting the immigrant ship\nthat Rekoro and I were on.
So that is why you asked if he\ncould be contacted, rather\nthan if he was safe.
...I was sent into the past at\nthe same time as Tika.
The difference between Tika\nand me was...

I was protected by Mastima at
a point eight years further
back than when you all arrived
at Daftine.
...So, does that mean this?

By the time Mr. Ricardo first met us, he
had already met Tika, who had been
sent into the past, during the battle in
Asyl.
That's about right.

That's why when I saw my
brother in the Rubarika Forest,
he was eight years older than
the brother I remembered.
Plus, he was wearing this mask,\nso I really couldn't tell who he\nwas...

It would be difficult indeed,
unless one already knew that
she had been sent into the
past.

B-but for someone who knew
that, you sure were aggressive
about trying to take Tika away
from us!
Correct. As expected of\nsomeone who understands the\nlogic of crossing space-time.
Hehehe, you see, my big\nbrother met me eight years\nago... right?
Shut it!

He was desperately trying to
change the future so that I
wouldn't have to go through
such terrible things.
Huh?
Well, all of those efforts were\nin vain, of course.
...You bastards...
...It's fine. I think I understand\nthat feeling a little.
Even in this short time, it's\nobvious that you two have\nalways been close.
Ehehe.
True. Well, as someone who\nwas blackmailed in various\nways, I have my complaints,

but I can certainly relate to the
feeling of not wanting to put
your loved ones through any
hardship.
...Don't act like you understand.\nIt makes my skin crawl.
...You've got a real difficult\npersonality, don't you?
I see...
Ugh...
Verda?
Ah, no, my apologies. I suppose\nthe fatigue is finally catching\nup with me.
But I am quite alright! I still\nhave plenty more to ask\nMastima!
Big sister Verda...

Mastima. Everyone has been
fighting non-stop since we
boarded the Asyl. Can we take
a break here for a bit?
I do not mind. Why not focus\non your recovery aboard that\nreborn ship of theirs?
A reborn ship!?
Exactly! If Tika is safe, then\nCoro and Rekoro must be safe\nas well. How are they faring!?
Of course they are! Let's go\nfind Coro first!
Coro said there were a lot of\nthings they wanted to tell\neveryone.
Coro and the ship both got\nway stronger thanks to Ex\nGiva!

Why the long faces? Over the
course of eight years, your
ship has been reborn beyond
recognition.
I guarantee it will be of great\nuse on your future travels\nthrough space.
...Easy for you to say.

...They say nothing is more
expensive than something
free... I have a bad feeling
about this.
Hehehe. Now then, shall we\nmove along?
This is... a teleportation rune!?
Space is just... something else,\nisn't it?
Indeed! We're on the Bridge. It\nseems we truly are safe!
Coro? Coro, where are you?\nCo-rooo?
Oh! Coro!
...GFSS-3214F crew member,\nVerda Kleiman, boarding\nconfirmed.
...Coro?
Ewin Laxter, Welch Vineyard,\nKarlyn Kayson, Vulca S90,
Henri Anle Henri, Tika Blanche,\nRicardo Blanche, Mastima,\nboarding confirmed...
And,
Captain.
Captain... Captain,\nCAPTAIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIN!!!!
Hieee!?
Captaaaaaaaain!!

I missed you! I've missed you
so much!! I can't even tell you
how much I've looked forward
to this day!!
Every second felt like an\neternity! It's been eight years!\nEight whole years!

All my loneliness! My love! My
heartache! My suffering! Let it
all reach you, Captain!
Captaaaaaaaain!!
...Wait, that's strange.
Why isn't Eve here with you? Is\nshe in the restroom?

...I was a fool to expect even a
shred of a touching reunion
with a grown-up Coro who's
crossed time and space.
What are you talking about,\nVerda?! I am the Federation's\nlatest AI!

With the added technology of Mastima
and Ex Giva, it wouldn't be an
exaggeration to say I'm now the newest
and strongest in the universe!!

Look at this agility! This processing
power! This offensive capability! This
storage capacity! No matter what kind
of Thornite appears, I alone can easily
repu...
*Click*.
Awa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa!!
I also threw in a runaway\nsuppression device as a bonus.
Now that's more like Coro. I\nalmost lost faith in you.
Ahhh! I've been longing for that\nkind of verbal abuse!
He's an unbreakable one.
Actually... there are a few\nthings I need to apologize to\neveryone for.
...It's kind of creepy when you\nsuddenly act all repentant.
...Especially to you, Valka.
To me?
Yes... the truth is...
I was the one... who shot down\nyour ship a year ago, Valka.
...Well, at this point, I had a\nfeeling that was the case.

To protect Lady Tika after she
was sent to Daftes, you would
have had to be stationed there
yourself, right?
Does that mean you're the one\nwho repelled Eldram's\nLevarance fleet too...?
Yes... that was me.

With Mastima's cloaking
equipment, they couldn't
detect my position at all, so it
was a breeze.
Most of the other things were\nmy doing as well.
Dropping Welch's lab in that\nspecific location,
Hijacking Tika's escape pod\nsignal and disguising it as a\nGalactic Federation signal...
It was all a setup to ensure we\ncould all reunite here at this\nvery moment.
...It's okay. I'm not angry.
Because thanks to you, I was\nable to meet my precious\nfriends.
We were saved by that power\nas well.
My sincerest thanks to you,\nCoro.
Uuu...! Valka... Henri...!
I agree with Henri. That's why...

I'll never forget that the reason
I crashed on Daftes wasn't due
to poor maintenance, but
because Coro shot me down.
Eh?
I won't forget. It wasn't\nmaintenance; Coro knocked me\nout of the sky.
...You're still holding a grudge\nabout that...
To me, it feels like it happened\njust the other day.
*Sigh*... I guess I should be\nmore careful with my words...
Ah... uh, about that! Did\nMastima handle all the\nmodifications?

I did, but I also had the help of
the people from across the
universe whom I protected with
Ex Giva.

You can assume that everything has
been upgraded to a completely
different level than when you were
flying them.
And with that power... there is\nsomething I want to ask of you.
...Well, I figured you wouldn't\nprovide such lavish\npreparations for nothing...
What exactly do you want us\nto do?
A variety of things.
What do you mean, "a variety\nof things"?!
I believe I've provided Tika,\nCoro, and the others with the\nbest care possible.

I intend to demand something
in return, though I believe my
requests won't be far off from
your own goals.

Well, you're likely anxious.
There are things you still want
to know, and things I wish to
tell you.
But for now, let's put that on\nhold.
You've been made to suffer\ntime and again by that Givel,\nhaven't you?
In such a state, you'll be\nuneasy about rescuing your\nkidnapped comrades.
Which is why... Tika.
Yes. ...Captain, everyone. After\nwe've had some rest...
Why don't we all level up\ntogether!
...Level up?
Tika. Ricardo. It seems you\nhave all successfully reunited.

Kyaaaaah! What is that?! What
is that!! There's something that
looks just like Valka over
there!?
No... that is a completely\nautonomous mobile weapon... a\nrobot soldier.
But it possesses an incredible\namount of Symbol power...
Welch Vineyard. That reaction\nbrings back many memories.
Huh?

My functions have improved
greatly over these eight years,
but my voice frequency should
remain unchanged.
...Wait a minute. That sound...\nthat voice... could it be...
Rekoro, is that you?
What!?
What!?
Rekoro, you say!?
Affirmative. I am Rekoro, the AI\nof the lifeboats aboard the\ntransport ship Kugo.
Y-your appearance seems to\nhave changed quite a bit...
Hmm? My exterior should not\nhave changed at all.
Ah, that's a familiar look.
Then, then what's with this\nrobot thing!? Is it something I\ncan take apart and study!?
No, that's definitely a no.

This robot is a body of the Ex
Giva general-purpose AI
weapon "Lambda," modified
specifically for Rekoro.

It incorporates Verda Kleiman's Arms
for combat training and activity
support on Daftine. It is also used for
daily security, cooking, laundry, and
cleaning.
In total, I oversee and operate\nfour "Lambda" units for Tika's\nsake!
...My, you certainly cover a\nwide range of duties.
Ever since Rekoro came to Ex\nGiva, they've been supporting\nevery part of my daily life.
I understand Tika's vitals\nbetter than anyone else.

And if Tika wishes to train
herself under Mastima's
protection, it is my duty to
support that.
But I really wish you'd stop\ntrying to make Lambda sleep\nnext to me at night...
Lucky! Lucky! What is this?!\nYou've basically got a servant\ndoll or a maid doll!
I'm not sure they look like\nservants or maids... but\nwhatever.
Does that mean Rekoro will\nalso be participating in combat\nusing Lambda from now on?

Negative. Due to the structure of my
personality program, I cannot engage in
combat actions, even when using
Lambda's body.

My fundamental nature as a lifeboat AI
remains unchanged; the act of harming
others is not envisioned within my
programming.
If I were to change that, I\nwould cease to be myself.

Therefore, the combat training I conduct with
Tika is strictly the physical and mental
development of Tika based on sports science,
not an act of combat where parties harm one
another.

Furthermore, the program that
operates these "Lambda"
bodies can only be maintained
by the computers on Ex Giva.
Once we reunite with the\nCaptain and return to the\nGFSS-3214F...
So you'll just go back to\noperating as a solo Rekoro, as\nusual.
Precisely.

However, as long as I have this
Lambda body, I can perform at
full capacity even during
defensive operations.

While I cannot counterattack
the enemy, I promise to
protect Tika, my primary
charge, at all costs.
You're as overprotective as\never.
That is also one of the charms\nof this AI.
If you wish, I can also assist\nwith the Captain's combat\ntraining.

While not as intensive as Tika's, I can
use the vital data you share with Coro
to help you improve yourselves as
much as you like.

The Galactic Federation's
Battle Simulators aren't bad,
but ours are built to a different
standard.
In "No Mercy" mode, people die\nas a matter of course.
Wait, that's exactly what's NOT\nsupposed to happen...
I can't tell you how many times\nI've had to step in and stop\nthem...
You've gotta be kidding me.

If you intend to use the simulator, it
would be better to use Colony Rapture
Day to rest your bodies rather than
returning to the ship.
A colony?
This Ex Giva is divided into five\nsections based on their\npurpose.

Centered around Cosmo City,
where those protected by
Mastima live, and Grand Daft
which sits above it,
it is further divided into\nRapture Day, Deis, and Grand\nMeteora for specific objectives.
I see, so a great number of\npeople are living there.
Exactly. Though there aren't\nmany areas you'll actually need\nto visit.
We certainly don't have much\ntime,

but for the sake of your goals
and mine... make sure you heal
your bodies and train
yourselves well.
Wait, Master Mastima! There's\nstill something I want to ask...!
The remaining details can wait\nuntil you've improved\nyourselves to a certain degree.
For now, let Rekoro train you.\nFarewell.
...Wh-what is with her?!
...Well, you'll get used to it.\nThat's just how she is; she\ndoesn't mean any harm.
I'm still not used to it.
I don't feel like I ever will!

Be that as it may, there is no doubt
that Mastima has sincerely protected
and guided Tika and the others. I want
you to trust her on that.
...True, if she is willing to be\nour ally, it would be unwise to\noppose her.
I suppose I shall take her up on\nher offer for now.

Captain, Mastima and Coro are
calling for you. It seems there
has been some movement in
Daftine.
If you are in good condition, I\nwould like you to proceed to\nthe bridge of GFSS-3214F.
Well, it's not like they're\nthinking about us. Let's answer\nthe call.
Indeed. Let us go.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> I've been waiting for you! I\nhave discovered Eve's location!
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Is that true?!
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Yes! I tracked a\nteleportation reaction that\nappeared to be Giverese,

and after searching the Imperial Capital
thoroughly, she had―quite carelessly, I
might add―simply returned to Baschen
Imperial Castle.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> In other words, to
rescue Eve, we must infiltrate
the Baschen Imperial Capital
once again.

<font color=blue>Euwin</font> Last time they said something
about not being able to contain us, but
now we have to sneak back into the
castle again, huh?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> No! Please, do not worry!

With the functions Mastima has
upgraded in me, there is no
longer any place in Daftine that
I cannot reach.

Whether it's the dungeons of Rubarika,
Asyl at the bottom of the sea, or the
Baschen Imperial Castle, I can teleport
us down anywhere.

However, the Imperial Capital
remains on high alert, so I
expect we will face significant
resistance.
<font color=blue>Welch</font> Why? Asyl is gone, so\nshouldn't this war be over?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> No messenger from\nDaftes has come down this\ntime.
